answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. What survives to the comet is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tundra.
